facts.claim: Illaoi is the prophet of the Great Kraken Nagakabouros and fights with a large golden idol.
Her kit creates and commands tentacles, rips an enemy champion's spirit from the body, and summons more tentacles with Leap of Faith.

emojiCandidates.meaning: a champion spirit pulled out as a Vessel

facts.claim: Irelia learned ancient Ionian dances and adapted them for war, levitating a host of deadly blades.
Her abilities include Bladesurge, Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge, all centered on moving and controlling blades.

emojiCandidates.meaning: the floating blades that define her combat style
Flawless Duet and paired blade movement
a visual shorthand for the graceful Ionian dance tradition

facts.claim: Ivern is the Green Father, a magically transformed being who protects the forests and their creatures.
Friend of the Forest lets Ivern free jungle monsters instead of killing them, while Brushmaker, Rootcaller and Triggerseed shape his nature-based kit.
Daisy is Ivern's distinctive large summoned companion.

emojiCandidates.meaning: the Green Father and living forest identity
a protected forest creature rather than a hunted camp
Daisy's name and gentle nature motif

facts.claim: Janna is an elemental wind spirit who protects the dispossessed of Zaun and is associated with sailors' prayers for fair winds.
Howling Gale, Zephyr, Eye of the Storm and Monsoon express wind, movement and protective shielding.

emojiCandidates.meaning: Howling Gale and the Storm's Fury identity
a benevolent spirit carried by the wind
Eye of the Storm and protection of Zaun's vulnerable people
the Shuriman roots of her ancient wind-spirit story

facts.claim: Jarvan IV is the Exemplar of Demacia and its crown prince, trained as a heavily armored royal warrior.
His signature kit links Dragon Strike to a Demacian Standard flag and ends with Cataclysm, a circular terrain arena.

source.title: Jarvan IV | League of Legends Wiki

emojiCandidates.meaning: royal heir and future king of Demacia
Dragon Strike and the dragon motif
Demacian armor and defensive Golden Aegis
the circular prison created by Cataclysm

facts.claim: Jax is a weapons master and the last known survivor of the Kohari of Icathia; he famously fights with an improvised lamp because he could not find a weapon worthy of him.
Leap Strike lets Jax leap to a unit, Counter Strike dodges basic attacks and stuns nearby enemies, and Grandmaster-at-Arms rewards repeated attacks.

emojiCandidates.meaning: the iconic lamppost/lamp Jax uses as a weapon
Grandmaster at Arms and mastery of weapons
his empowered weapon attacks and relentless dueling pressure

facts.claim: Jayce Talis is Piltover's Defender of Tomorrow, a hextech inventor who carries the Mercury Hammer.
Jayce swaps between Mercury Hammer and Mercury Cannon forms, with Shock Blast, Acceleration Gate and Thundering Blow defining the kit.
Jhin is a meticulous Ionian serial killer and artist whose murders are treated as elaborate performances.
Whisper uses four rounds with a guaranteed critical fourth shot, while Captive Audience and Curtain Call turn flowers, traps and a cannon into theatrical motifs.

emojiCandidates.meaning: four rounds and the famous fourth shot
the masked performer and theatrical murders
beauty, flowers and Captive Audience traps
Whisper and the transformed Curtain Call cannon
a staged finale and Curtain Call performance

facts.claim: Jinx is the Loose Cannon of Zaun, known for reckless destruction and a love of explosions and chaos.
She switches between the Pow-Pow minigun and Fishbones rocket launcher, throws Flame Chompers, and fires a global Super Mega Death Rocket.

emojiCandidates.meaning: Fishbones and Super Mega Death Rocket
Pow-Pow minigun and her weapon switching
the burst of speed and attack speed from Get Excited

facts.claim: K'Sante is the Pride of Nazumah, a monster hunter and protector of a desert city in Shurima.
He fights with paired Ntofo weapons, combining tank defenses with a distinctive All Out transformation that trades defenses for offensive power.
His kit uses shields, wall interaction and a form-changing ultimate to move from protector to fighter.

emojiCandidates.meaning: All Out changes his form and tradeoff

unresolved: Generic shield and fist symbols are not uniquely K'Sante without the desert and transformation clues.

facts.claim: Kai'Sa survived the Void after being taken as a child and now lives in uneasy symbiosis with a living Void carapace.
Second Skin stacks Plasma and her Living Weapon identity evolves her abilities as she gains stats; Icathian Rain and Void Seeker are core attacks.

emojiCandidates.meaning: a living protective shell or carapace
symbiosis and evolving Living Weapon abilities
her ranged hunter weapons and Icathian Rain
a precise Void hunter tracking prey

unresolved: The shell emoji is an inference for a carapace and may read as marine rather than Void-themed on some platforms.

facts.claim: Kalista is an undead wraith from Camavor and the Spear of Vengeance, bound to hunt those who betray an oath.
Her kit is built around Martial Poise hopping, Rend spears embedded in a target, and Fate's Call with an Oathsworn ally.

emojiCandidates.meaning: undead wraith and Black Mist origin
the Oathsworn bond and Fate's Call
Martial Poise makes every attack a hop
the Black Mist and Shadow Isles atmosphere

facts.claim: Karma is the living embodiment of an ancient Ionian soul reincarnated through countless lives, carrying accumulated memories.
Gathering Fire reduces Mantra's cooldown, and Mantra empowers her damaging, tethering and shielding abilities.

unresolved: Reincarnation has no perfectly literal single emoji; the cycle symbol is a deliberate rebus inference.

facts.claim: Karthus is the Deathsinger, an undead lich associated with the Shadow Isles and a desire to welcome death.
Death Defied lets him cast after dying, while Requiem is a global death-themed song and Defile surrounds him with damaging aura.

emojiCandidates.meaning: Death Defied and continuing after death
undead spirit and Shadow Isles haunting
the Shadow Isles and Black Mist atmosphere

facts.claim: Kassadin is the Void Walker, a father who crossed into the Void and armed himself with artifacts to rescue his daughter Kai'Sa.
Void Stone, Null Sphere, Nether Blade and Riftwalk make his kit a Void-themed melee fighter with repeated short-range teleportation.

emojiCandidates.meaning: the Void and crossing a rift

unresolved: Void symbols overlap with other Void champions; the blade plus repeated rift clues are the intended distinction.

facts.claim: Katarina is a high-caliber Noxian assassin and the eldest daughter of General Du Couteau.
She throws bouncing daggers, Shunpos to units or daggers, and uses Death Lotus; takedowns dramatically reduce remaining cooldowns.

emojiCandidates.meaning: serrated daggers and Sinister Blade identity
Bouncing Blade and returning dagger trajectory
Shunpo movement and spinning Death Lotus

facts.claim: Kayle is a Targonian Aspect who fought for justice with wings of divine flame and served as a protector of Demacia with Morgana.
Divine Ascent progressively grants wings, range and waves of fire, while Divine Judgment makes a target invulnerable.
Kayn is a shadow assassin who wields the Darkin scythe Rhaast and battles for control of his body and mind.
The Darkin Scythe, Shadow Step and Umbral Trespass support two possible forms: Shadow Assassin and Rhaast, with different combat identities.

signatureSignals: walking through walls and possessing targets

emojiCandidates.meaning: a readable axe-like shorthand for his scythe
the choice between Kayn and Rhaast forms

unresolved: Unicode has no scythe emoji; axe is an imperfect visual proxy and should be reviewed against the renderer.

facts.claim: Kennen is the Heart of the Tempest, a Yordle and member of the Kinkou who uses lightning to mediate the mortal and spirit realms.
His abilities apply Marks of the Storm, and three marks stun; Lightning Rush turns him into a moving ball of electricity.

emojiCandidates.meaning: lightning element and Heart of the Tempest
stacking Marks of the Storm on targets

facts.claim: Kha'Zix is a Voidreaver who infiltrated Runeterra to devour the strongest creatures and evolve beyond them.
Taste Their Fear rewards isolated targets, Leap provides a sudden jump, and Void Assault grants stealth; several abilities can evolve.

emojiCandidates.meaning: hunting isolated prey and unseen threat

facts.claim: Kindred is the Eternal Hunters represented by two entities: Lamb and Wolf, two faces of death in Runeterra.
Marks of the Kindred grow through hunts, Wolf's Frenzy summons Wolf to attack, and Lamb's Respite creates a zone that prevents units from dying briefly.

emojiCandidates.meaning: Wolf, the other half and companion
two complementary faces of one death concept
the two masks/faces of the Eternal Hunters

facts.claim: Kled is a cantankerous Noxian Yordle cavalier who rides the cowardly lizard Skaarl.
His kit features Bear Trap on a Rope, Jousting, a dismounted state with courage, and the long-range Chaaaaaaaarge ultimate.

emojiCandidates.meaning: Chaaaaaaaarge and his reckless rallying cry

facts.claim: Kog'Maw is a putrid Void creature from Icathia with a caustic, gaping mouth.
Caustic Spittle, Bio-Arcane Barrage, Void Ooze and Living Artillery make acid, ooze and long-range biological artillery central to his kit; Icathian Surprise explodes on death.
LeBlanc is the Deceiver, a pale woman and central manipulator of the Black Rose who works through hidden identities and illusions.
Mirror Image, Distortion, Ethereal Chains and Mimic let her create a clone, blink, bind targets and repeat spells.
Lee Sin is the Blind Monk, an Ionian martial artist who lost his sight and follows a path of atonement.
Sonic Wave, Safeguard, Dragon's Rage and his ward-assisted movement define his recognizable martial-arts gameplay.

source.title: Lee Sin | League of Legends Wiki

emojiCandidates.meaning: blindness and the blind monk title

facts.claim: Leona is the Radiant Dawn, a Targonian Aspect who serves the power of the sun and fights in golden armor with a shield and sword.
Shield of Daybreak, Eclipse, Zenith Blade and Solar Flare make sunlight, shielded initiation and stuns the core of her kit.

emojiCandidates.meaning: Shield of Daybreak and tank support

facts.claim: Lillia is the Bashful Bloom, a shy magical fawn who gathers dreams in an enchanted Ionian forest.
Dream Dust marks enemies, Swirlseed rolls like a seed, and Lilting Lullaby puts marked enemies to sleep.
Lissandra is the Ice Witch of the Freljord who corrupts nature with black ice and plots an ice age.
Ice Shard, Ring of Frost, Glacial Path and Frozen Tomb make ice, teleporting through a claw and self-encasement in dark ice central to her kit.
Her lore is closely tied to the hidden Watchers and the frozen north.

emojiCandidates.meaning: the Ice Witch's Freljord leadership and ancient sisters

facts.claim: Locke is the Ashen Exorcist, a Demacian champion introduced by Riot in 2026 with a demon-hunting identity.

source.title: Locke: The Ashen Exorcist | Champion Trailer

facts.claim: Public secondary references list Silver Stake, Ritual Nails, Soul Ignition, Ashen Pursuit and Purgatory, including self-ignition, soul nails and a binding artifact.

source.title: Locke - Liquipedia League of Legends Wiki

facts.claim: Locke's public profile emphasizes ash, exorcism, soul sealing and damage that can be converted into healing after Soul Ignition.

source.title: Locke - League of Legends Esports Wiki

emojiCandidates.meaning: ash cloud and the Ashen title
Purgatory's binding artifact and soul sealing

unresolved: Locke is a new champion and Unicode has no precise exorcist/soul-nail symbol; the set relies on an ash-spirit-binding rebus and needs player validation.

facts.claim: Lucian is a Sentinel of Light who hunts wraiths with twin relic pistols after Thresh killed his wife Senna.
Lightslinger fires a second shot after every ability, while Piercing Light, Relentless Pursuit and The Culling make double-gun mobility central to gameplay.

emojiCandidates.meaning: wraiths and the Black Mist enemy
Black Mist and the grief/vengeance thread

facts.claim: Lulu is a Bandle City Yordle mage who travels with her fairy companion Pix and warps reality through whimsical magic.
Pix, Whimsy, Help Pix and Wild Growth define her kit through a fairy companion, polymorph, shielding and sudden size increase.

emojiCandidates.meaning: Wild Growth making an ally suddenly huge

unresolved: There is no literal Pix emoji; fairy plus transformation clues are intended to carry the companion identity.

facts.claim: Luxanna Crownguard is a Demacian mage who can manipulate light while hiding her powers in a society suspicious of magic.
Illumination, Light Binding, Prismatic Barrier, Lucent Singularity and Final Spark make light, bindings, shields and a long laser her defining kit.

emojiCandidates.meaning: Lady of Luminosity and light magic
